title: Back up & restore: add button to open backup directory
author: Dobypeti

status.label: Milestoned Settings enhancement
status.detail: The requested folder-open command is narrow, accepted into 0.102, and maps to the existing backup-location card.

next_action.label: Complete implementation design
next_action.reason: Specify launch behavior, unavailable-path handling, localization, accessibility, and tests before approval.

judgment.rationale: The user scenario is concrete, the issue is milestoned, and current Settings code exposes both the backup path and the exact UI card where an open-folder command belongs.
evidence: The issue is in the PowerToys 0.102 milestone.
GeneralPage.xaml already displays the backup directory and provides a folder-selection button.
GeneralViewModel exposes SettingsBackupAndRestoreDir but has no command to open the current directory.
judgment.recommended_action: Prepare an implementation-grade design for an accessible Open backup folder command with safe missing-path behavior.

issue_context.summary: The Back up & Restore settings show and let users change the backup location, but provide no direct way to open it in File Explorer.
known_information: The reporter wants quicker access for renaming or deleting backup files.
The existing Settings card displays SettingsBackupAndRestoreDir and has a Select folder button.
The issue has been assigned to the 0.102 milestone.
inferences: A second action on the existing location card can reuse the resolved backup directory without changing backup storage semantics.
The command needs explicit behavior when the configured directory is empty, missing, or inaccessible.
issue_context.analysis: This is a small accepted enhancement with clear code ownership. The artifact remains design_in_progress because it does not yet contain a complete file-by-file plan and verification matrix.
initial_investigation: Confirmed there is no current open-directory command in the backup and restore section.

information_gaps.information: Expected behavior for an unset or deleted backup directory
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether the command is disabled, creates the directory, or surfaces an error.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Resolve as a maintainer UX decision in the implementation design.
